name: Berend Weij

role.en: Interaction designer & developer, owner of Studio Zoetekauw
role.nl: Interaction designer & developer, eigenaar van Studio Zoetekauw

shortBio.en: Professional developer since 2000, specialised in serious games and interactive media.
shortBio.nl: Professioneel developer sinds 2000, gespecialiseerd in serious games en interactieve media.

en: Cross-functional expertise in project management, usability, interaction design and development for (educational) games, websites and other interactive media. Professional developer since 2000.
Previously founder and technical director of Mijn naam is Haas, currently owner of [Studio Zoetekauw](http://www.studiozoetekauw.nl/).
nl: Brede expertise in projectmanagement, usability, interaction design en development voor (educatieve) games, websites en andere interactieve media. Professioneel developer sinds 2000.
Eerder oprichter en technisch directeur van Mijn naam is Haas, nu eigenaar van [Studio Zoetekauw](http://www.studiozoetekauw.nl/).
